title: DesignSpec
description: User experience, interaction model, and visual design requirements. Contract between product requirements and implementation. Version 4.0.0.

reqId.description: Functional requirement identifier, format REQ-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

usId.description: User story identifier, format US-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

fnId.description: Function ID from ApiSpec. Format: FN-camelCase, e.g. 'FN-createUser'.

uxacId.description: UX acceptance criterion identifier, format UXAC-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

vdrId.description: Visual design requirement identifier, format VDR-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

arId.description: Accessibility requirement identifier, format AR-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

namedRequirement.description: A verifiable design requirement with a stable ID.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this requirement.

description.description: The requirement in plain language. Must be verifiable — avoid subjective terms.

iaNode.description: A node in the information architecture tree.

name.description: Label as it appears in navigation.

screenRef.description: Screen ID this node navigates to. Required for leaf nodes.

children.description: Child nodes. If present, this is a grouping node — screenRef should be omitted.

dgId.description: Design goal identifier, format DG-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

spcId.description: Screen spec identifier, format SPC-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

patId.description: Interaction pattern identifier, format PAT-NNN (3-digit zero-padded).

version.description: Semver version of this designspec document instance.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the DesignSpec schema this document conforms to. Must be '4.0.0'.

project.description: Must match the project name in the corresponding GoalSpec.

goalSpecVersion.description: Version of the GoalSpec this design was produced against.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this design element. One of: draft, confirmed, deprecated.

designGoals.description: High-level UX objectives. Each must describe a desired user experience quality, not an implementation approach.

id.description: Unique identifier for this design goal.

goal.description: A UX quality the design must achieve.

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this design goal.

description.description: Longer description of this design goal and how it will be achieved.

rationale.description: Why this design goal matters for this project.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this design goal.

reqRefs.description: REQ-NNN IDs from GoalSpec that this goal addresses.

personas.description: Descriptions of target users. Persona roles must be consistent with actors in the GoalSpec.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this persona (e.g. 'power-developer').

name.description: Human name for the persona, e.g. 'Leon'.

description.description: A brief description of this persona's role, context, and motivations.

role.description: The actor role this persona represents. Should match an actor named in GoalSpec.

goals.description: What this persona is trying to accomplish.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this persona.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) that this persona's role maps to. Use for cross-spec traceability with actors in GoalSpec.

userJourneys.description: End-to-end workflows from the user's perspective. Each must reference a GoalSpec user story.

id.description: Unique identifier for this user journey (e.g. 'UJ-001').

name.description: Short descriptive name for this user journey.

description.description: A brief description of this user journey. May restate startingState and desiredOutcome in one sentence.

personaRef.description: The persona this journey belongs to.

usRefs.description: US-IDs from GoalSpec this journey implements. Must not be empty.

reqRefs.description: REQ-NNN-slug IDs from GoalSpec that this journey exercises end-to-end.

fnRefs.description: FN-IDs from ApiSpec that this journey exercises. Populated during implementation planning. Use for UJ→FN traceability.

startingState.description: What the user and system state are at the beginning of this journey.

steps.description: Ordered steps alternating user actions and system responses.

action.description: What they do or what happens.

screenRef.description: Screen the user is on during this step, if applicable.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in this step's action description.

desiredOutcome.description: The end state the user has reached when the journey succeeds.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in this journey.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this journey.

informationArchitecture.description: Navigation structure of the application. Leaf nodes must reference screen IDs.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for the information architecture.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in the information architecture.

screenInventory.description: All screens and views in the system. Screen IDs are the shared key referenced throughout the spec.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this screen (e.g. 'library-screen').

description.description: Longer description of the screen's purpose and behavior. If omitted, 'purpose' is used as fallback.

purpose.description: One sentence: what the user accomplishes on this screen.

primaryActions.description: The main things a user can do on this screen.

inputs.description: Data or content the user provides on this screen.

outputs.description: Data or content the screen produces or displays.

usRefs.description: US-NNN-slug IDs this screen helps fulfil.

fnRefs.description: FN-IDs from ApiSpec that this screen's interactions exercise. Populated during implementation planning. Use for SCR→FN traceability.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in the screen's purpose description.

ujRefs.description: UJ-NNN IDs from DesignSpec user journeys that use this screen.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this screen.

reqRefs.description: REQ-NNN IDs from GoalSpec that this screen implements.

screenSpecs.description: Detailed specifications for each screen. Must cover every screen in the inventory.

screenRef.description: Must match a screen ID in the screen inventory.

layout.description: Description of the spatial arrangement of elements on this screen.

wireframe.description: ASCII sketch or description of the low-fidelity layout. Not intended to define final visuals.

components.description: UI components present on this screen.

purpose.description: What this component does for the user.

designSystemRef.description: Name of the design system component this maps to, if applicable.

patternRefs.description: Interaction pattern IDs that apply to this component.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in this component's purpose description.

states.description: All distinct visual/interaction states this screen can be in.

description.description: What the screen looks like and how it behaves in this state.

interactions.description: User interactions available on this screen.

trigger.description: What the user does, e.g. 'Presses Enter in query field'.

response.description: What the system does in response.

patternRef.description: Interaction pattern this follows, if applicable.

glossaryRefs.description: Glossary term IDs (GL-NNN) referenced in this screen spec.

id.description: Unique identifier for this screen spec.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this screen spec.

interactionPatterns.description: Reusable interaction rules defined once and referenced throughout screen specs.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier for this interaction pattern (e.g. 'keyboard-navigation').

name.description: Short descriptive name for this interaction pattern.

description.description: How this pattern behaves from the user's perspective.

examples.description: Concrete instances of this pattern in the UI.

keyboardShortcuts.description: Keyboard shortcuts associated with this pattern.

action.description: What the key combination does when pressed.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this pattern.

usageNotes.description: How and when to use this pattern.

visualDesignRequirements.description: Appearance constraints. Must describe requirements, not artistic preferences.

rationale.description: Why this visual design requirement matters.

designSystem.description: Reusable UI building blocks that define consistency across the product.

purpose.description: What this component communicates or enables.

variants.description: Named variants of this component, e.g. 'primary', 'destructive', 'ghost'.

usageNotes.description: Guidance on when and how to use this design system component.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for the design system.

accessibilityRequirements.description: Accessibility expectations. Each must be independently verifiable.

uxAcceptanceCriteria.description: Design-specific success criteria. Each must be binary, verifiable, and linked to a GoalSpec story or requirement.

id.description: Unique identifier for this UX acceptance criterion (e.g. 'UXAC-001').

name.description: Short descriptive name summarizing this UX acceptance criterion (e.g. 'New Research Session').

description.description: A binary pass/fail UX condition. Must not be subjective.

refs.description: At least one US-ID or REQ-ID must be provided.

usRefs.description: US-NNN IDs from GoalSpec user stories this criterion relates to.

reqRefs.description: REQ-NNN IDs from GoalSpec functional requirements this criterion measures.

verificationMethod.description: How this criterion will be verified, e.g. 'manual walkthrough', 'automated UI test'.

notes.description: Optional clarifying context for this criterion.

designTokens.description: Design tokens that define visual consistency across the product

id.description: Unique identifier for this design token, format DT-NNN-tokenName.

category.description: The design dimension this token belongs to

description.description: When and how this token should be used.

glossaryRefs.description: GL-NNN identifiers for related glossary terms.
